checks.title: Stuck actuators (joints that never move)
checks.summary: every joint moves wherever the dataset uses it

findings.message: joint 0 (motor_0) does not move in 3/250 episodes [63, 86, 161] - it moves in the others - dead or disabled motor during those recordings? [two-level on/off command]
joint 3 (motor_3) does not move in 192/250 episodes [0, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 17]... - the task may not need it in every episode

joint 6 (motor_6) does not move in 93/250 episodes [3, 13, 18, 20, 22, 23, 32, 33]... - the task may not need it in every episode [dim looks like an unnamed gripper]

checks.title: Action saturation (commands clipped at the limits)
checks.summary: no continuous action dim pinned at a limit above 5% (0 dims checked)

findings.message: observation.state dim 6: constant (std=0) - carries no signal; if it ever varies at deployment, mean/std normalization (std + 1e-8) blows it up. Usually padding; consider dropping it
